caseStudy.summary: A WordPress storefront for a UK tile retailer, presenting its ranges to retail and trade buyers.
caseStudy.executiveSummary: Fine Deco Tiles has an online presence at finedecotiles.co.uk. This case study documents the website and its e-commerce experience. Project scope, implementation details and measurable outcomes should be added after confirmation by the project team.
caseStudy.aboutClient: Fine Deco Tiles is a tile shop based in Iver, Slough, supplying a wide range of wall and floor tiles. The business highlights large-format floor tiles suitable for underfloor heating, and uses its site to showcase ranges and inspiration for customers planning a room.
caseStudy.conclusion: The site is live at finedecotiles.co.uk, where the current tile ranges and contact details are published.
